## Page
- Page number: (01–40)
- Source: `pages/en/`
- Target: `pages/hi/`

## Task
- [ ] Translate the page following the style guide and glossary
- [ ] Self-check (glossary terms, formatting, no untranslated prose)
- [ ] Open a pull request
- [ ] Get reviewer + approver sign-off

## Glossary
Use only approved terms from `glossary/glossary.csv` (mirrors the Notion glossary).
